name: shop
why: Small local benchmark target sized for 8B local models: 2 projects, 23 C# files. It contains an interface with direct and base-class implementations plus a look-alike class that does not implement it, two overloads of one method, and a same-named method on an unrelated interface, so it exercises the same find, impact and change navigation as the Jellyfin suite in a context a small model can hold.
